# Video Brief: "Kanban Makes Itself"

## Concept

A recursive demonstration video for Hermes Agent's Kanban feature.
The video shows the Kanban system creating the very video you're watching.

**Two-part structure:**

### Part 1: "The Setup" (captured by user in Screen Studio)
- User types the kanban command in terminal
- Dashboard shows tasks fan out and execute
- Split view: terminal (left) + dashboard (right)
- Sped up 4-8x, cut to ~20 seconds by creative team
- **This part is NOT generated by the pipeline** — it's captured live

### Part 2: "The Output" (generated by this pipeline)
- The actual video the kanban workers produce
- Explains how Kanban works, end-to-end
- Uses brand assets, colors, music
- ~60-90 seconds
- Ends with Nous logo

### The Transition
Part 1's dashboard shows the final task complete → hard cut or glitch → Part 2 plays.
The viewer realizes: "that's what it just made."

---

## Part 2 Specification (What the Pipeline Produces)

### Duration: ~75 seconds
### Audio: Doomscroll.mp3 (2:39, will use first ~80s)
### Aspect Ratio: 16:9 (1920x1080)
### Primary Renderer: ASCII video (audio-reactive)
### Secondary Renderer: p5.js (for specific scenes)

### Scene Breakdown (mapped to Doomscroll's energy arc)

| # | Time | Song Section | Visual | Renderer | Description |
|---|------|-------------|--------|----------|-------------|
| 1 | 0:00-0:12 | Intro (atmospheric) | Title card | ascii | "HERMES KANBAN" in pixel text, ambient particle field, breathing glow |
| 2 | 0:12-0:30 | Build 1 (percussion enters) | Task creation | ascii | ASCII boxes form as "tasks" — typing effect reveals task titles one by one |
| 3 | 0:30-0:49 | Main groove | Fan-out visualization | p5js | Particle system: central node explodes into 5 worker particles, each trailing to their own lane |
| 4 | 0:49-1:07 | Build 2 (melodic) | Workers processing | ascii | Split screen: multiple ASCII "terminals" running simultaneously, heartbeat pulses |
| 5 | 1:07-1:24 | Pre-drop (tension) | Dependencies resolving | p5js | Graph visualization: edges light up as parent→child deps resolve, nodes turn gold |
| 6 | 1:24-1:42 | Peak energy | Pipeline completion | ascii | Rapid cascade: tasks slide from Running→Done, final compositor assembles, screen fills with gold characters |
| 7 | 1:42-2:00 | Outro start | Logo reveal | ascii | Characters converge to form Nous badge shape, gold on black, fade with particle dispersion |

### Visual Rules (per brand guide)
- Background: Always `#000000`
- Primary accent: `#F5B820` (gold) for completed states, success, reveals
- Secondary: `#0000FF` (blue) for in-progress states, data, connections
- Text characters: Mix of pixel blocks and mystical glyphs
- Audio-reactive: Bass drives background intensity, hi-hats trigger particle spawns, beats trigger transition flashes

### Text/Copy to Display
- Scene 1: "HERMES KANBAN"
- Scene 2: Task titles appearing: "research", "implement", "review", "deploy"
- Scene 3: Profile names: "@researcher", "@engineer", "@reviewer"
- Scene 6: "DONE" in large pixel font
- Scene 7: Nous badge / "nousresearch.com"

### Technical Notes
- Each scene renders as a separate clip (per-clip architecture)
- Compositor stitches with crossfade transitions at beat points
- Audio muxed at final stage
- ffmpeg: `-c:v libx264 -crf 18 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p`
